name: Evernote import
description: Brings in notes from Evernote .enex files (File, Export notes in Evernote): text with its formatting, checklists, links, tags and pictures. Notebooks you export one by one become folders by their file names.
author: Notation

importers.title: Evernote
importers.description: Pick one or more .enex files (one for each notebook), or a zip of them.
